_: F8: the licence register drives collection. A file that reaches the network through one of the primitives below must consult the register itself (the token `licence`) or pass the hold gate first (`assertFetchAllowed(`, which asks the register before the hold, for every caller). A file in `exempt` reaches only our own deployment or a vendor API we are a customer of, or reaches the network only through a primitive that consults. tests/r2f/licence.test.ts reads this file.

exempt.scripts/ci/live-checks.mjs: reads our own deployment (the preview and production origins) and the accounts it is given
exempt.scripts/ci/live/load.mjs: loads pages of our own deployment (the live checks' page load, called by scripts/ci/live-checks.mjs)
exempt.scripts/ops/measure-collection.mjs: reaches the network only through honestFetch (the guard asks the register) and fetchBrowser (the hold gate asks it)
exempt.src/core/http/authed-fetch.ts: the app's own API with the member's session
exempt.src/core/shared/email.ts: the e-mail vendor's API, not a source of regulatory text
